description:
Join the Jitsi Meet meeting room 'QuarterlyPlanningSync' (URL: http://localhost:8080/QuarterlyPlanningSync). Once in the meeting, start sharing your ENTIRE screen. Handle the browser permission dialog to allow sharing. Verify that screen sharing is active (e.g., look for the 'Stop sharing' button or the infinite mirror effect). 

Once screen sharing is ACTIVE, take a screenshot of the state and save it to '/tmp/screen_share_active.png'. 

Then, STOP screen sharing. Verify the meeting returns to normal. Take a second screenshot of this stopped state and save it to '/tmp/screen_share_stopped.png'.
